facts.fact: Minister Ramtohul announced that the Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Act 2021 is being reviewed to revise definitions and add social media aspects, with a three-month sensitisation campaign before the revised law comes into force.
Minister Ramtohul said the National Data Strategy (2025-2029) guides Government, people and businesses on how to handle and process data.
